notes.title: Celebrating One Year of Universe for Sale
notes.notes:
Hey cultists,

About a year ago, we launched [i]Universe for Sale[/i] which was a beautiful, hand-drawn interactive story which pulled on the heart strings of the audience. Yes, we are technically a month late and it was 13 months ago since launch but uhhh… Jupiter has 13 month years. Yeah, let's go with that.

I talked a little with Tmesis Studio about [i]Universe for Sale[/i] in celebration of the one year anniversary and wanted to tell you a little story about how Universe for Sale came to be.

Federico met Zeno by chance 10 years ago during an evening out. When Federico learned that Zeno was a comic book artist they collaborated on [i]The Spirits of Kelley Family[/i] which was released a few months later. Tmesis Studio was officially formed years later with the creation of [i]Universe for [Sale[/i] after several years of personal projects.

Zeno remembered a time when Federico was cleaning up their Telegram chat to get organized but he didn’t realize that deleted a lot of the backups they had sent to each other for the project. Thankfully, nothing current was lost but they couldn’t revisit some older iterations.

Tmesis had trouble coming up with the right idea for an indie game of their own. While Zeno and Federico spent countless nights pitching some ideas and discarding others, they eventually settled on pushing themselves to create something a bit out of the ordinary.

[i]Universe for Sale[/i] started as a comic book in which the game remains extremely similar to the original comic idea. Tmesis Studio said the biggest challenge was creating a gameplay rhythm that maintained player attention, especially during dialogue-heavy moments. The pacing, character interactions, and even some plot points had to be adapted to fit the interactive nature of a video game while ensuring the players stayed engaged.

Some changes that had to be made to the story when transitioning it to a video game to help it flow. A lot of the lore and details were initially more static in the comic format. For the game, Tmesis Studio had to create more dynamic story beats and dialogue to ensure the player felt actively involved. They also added branching conversations that could change based on player choices. Most of these changes were to give the player some control over the progression of the story, making the narrative itself a part of the gameplay.

Tmesis Studio wants players to feel like they've sat down for a chat with old friends in a warm, comfortable place. The universe may be vast and strange, but it's the small, human connections that make it feel alive and real.

To celebrate, you can get the game for 18% off in the steam winter sale until Jan 2nd. Now's a great time to pick up the game! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627840/Universe_For_Sale/ 

-riv otter

notes.title: Universe for Sale - save system change patch
notes.notes:
Hey cultists,

We have just released a patch which changes the save system in Universe for Sale which makes them more stable.

Unfortunately, saves from before this patch can’t be carried over to this new save system. We have opened a beta branch which will allow players to continue saves from before this patch.

To join the beta branch follow these steps.
[olist]
[*] Right click Universe for Sale on the side bar and click properties
[*] Click the Beta tab in the Steam window that opens up
[*] In the drop down menu in Beta Participation, select "old-savegame"
[*] Steam should start downloading the branch automatically and you’ll be on the old save system again!
[/olist]
Thank you all for working with us.

- Riv Otter

notes.title: Build 1.0.5z - Upcoming Save System Changes
notes.notes:
We are happy to tell you that our next update will significantly improve the game's stability!

However, to achieve this, we had to change how the game saves progress completely. The old saving system caused many issues.

We advise you to update to the newest version when we release it shortly. But, doing so means you will lose your existing save progress.

If you want to keep playing on your current save, we've moved this game version (1.0.5z) to the "old-savegame" branch on Steam. 

Please set this in your Steam game settings!

notes.title: Nominate Universe for Sale for Outstanding Visual Style
notes.notes:
Hey, cultist!

First off, thank you for the amazing release of [i]Universe for Sale[/i]. It has been great to be able to share with you the beautiful heart wrenching story that [i]Universe for Sale[/i] tells.

Steam Awards voting starts now! The Steam Awards are a community-voted celebration of the best games on Steam, announced every year. There are many categories that we can vote for however it is best we unite to vote on one category for Universe for Sale!!

We're asking players to band together and vote [i]Universe for Sale[/i] for [b]Outstanding Visual Style[/b].

Every scene in [i]Universe for Sale[/i] is beautifully hand drawn showing off the warm colors of Jupiter’s environment in the space colony with each character having a unique appearance!  

-Riv Otter

notes.title: Universe for Sale out now!
notes.notes:
Hello Cultists,

[b][i]Universe for Sale[/i], a point and click virtual novel is out now![/b]

https://youtu.be/EwwqcNjSbrc

Follow the adventures of a cultist, whose past is written on his face and bones, visiting a space colony nestled in the clouds on Jupiter. Under a failing shield against acid rain, rebellion foments in the discarded populace of this abandoned mining settlement.

Within this mysterious community, a young woman crafts universes in the same way you or I might brew a cup of tea. She has a little shop tucked away in the ramshackle bazaar. What universe will you buy there?

Heading into launch, [i]Universe for Sale[/i] won Best Art at BIG 2023 for its stunning hand drawn art and also took home Best Narrative at the Overcome Film Game Awards for its heart wrenching storytelling! 

-Riv Otter

notes.title: We reach the finals at the Big Indie Pitch!
notes.notes:
We made it guys! [b]We arrived 3rd at the Big Indie Pitch competition!![/b] :)
We had to present the project in "[b]Elevator pitch mode ON[/b]" (5 minutes max) in different rooms to a diverse jury of journalists and experts in the field. 
I assure you that 5 minutes are very few to make the jury feel [b]the universe we are creating[/b] ;) 
But they rewarded us with a nice [b]third place[/b]!
